items.distractor_fact: Termometr laboratoryjny używany do wzorcowania wskazywał tego dnia {D} °C.
items.gloss_en: A laboratory thermometer used for calibration showed {D} °C that day.
items.entity_note: a calibration lab's own instrument (an instrument), not a weather station in a neighboring town (a place) as in the first distractor, and not the morning/afternoon reading the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Cena, po jakiej inny inwestor odsprzedał swoje akcje tego samego dnia, wynosiła {D} zł.
items.gloss_en: The price at which a different investor resold their own shares that same day was {D} zł.
items.entity_note: a private investor's own resale price (a person), not a different company's listed stock (an organisation) as in the first distractor, and not the opening/closing price the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Lokalne przedsiębiorstwo wodociągowe podało tego dnia poziom wody we własnym zbiorniku, wynoszący {D} m.
items.gloss_en: The local water utility company reported the water level in its own reservoir that day as {D} m.
items.entity_note: a water utility company's own separate reservoir (an organisation), not simply a neighboring reservoir (a place) as in the first distractor, and not the reservoir whose morning/evening level the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Firma kurierska użyła własnej przesyłki wzorcowej do kontroli wagi, która ważyła {D} kg.
items.gloss_en: The courier company used its own reference parcel for a weight check, which weighed {D} kg.
items.entity_note: the courier company's own calibration parcel (an organisation), not simply a different parcel sent that day (an item) as in the first distractor, and not the parcel whose weight before/after the journey the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Bank posiadał własny rachunek rezerwowy, na którym zgromadzono {D} zł.
items.gloss_en: The bank held its own reserve account, on which {D} zł had been accumulated.
items.entity_note: the bank's own reserve account (an organisation), not a different customer's account (a person) as in the first distractor, and not the customer's account whose deposit and spending the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Inny klient banku przechowywał na swoim rachunku oszczędnościowym {D} zł.
items.gloss_en: A different bank client kept {D} zł in their own savings account.
items.entity_note: a different client's own savings account (a person), not another term-deposit instrument at the same bank (an instrument) as in the first distractor, and not the deposit whose contribution and withdrawal the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Niezależny wykonawca, niezwiązany z tą firmą, osiągnął w tym miesiącu przychód w wysokości {D} zł.
items.gloss_en: An independent contractor, unrelated to this company, earned revenue of {D} zł that month.
items.entity_note: an independent contractor's own revenue (a person), not another company in the same industry (an organisation) as in the first distractor, and not the firm whose income and expenses the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Liczba goli zdobytych indywidualnie przez jednego zawodnika w tym sezonie wynosiła {D}.
items.gloss_en: The number of goals scored individually by one player this season was {D}.
items.entity_note: an individual player's own personal tally (a person), not a different team in the same league (an organisation) as in the first distractor, and not the team whose goals scored and conceded the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Fundusz inwestycyjny, niezwiązany z tym inwestorem, osiągnął w tym roku zyski w wysokości {D} zł.
items.gloss_en: An investment fund unrelated to this investor achieved gains of {D} zł that year.
items.entity_note: an investment fund's own gains (an organisation), not a different individual investor (a person) as in the first distractor, and not the investor whose gains and losses the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: W osobnym turnieju rozegranym tego samego weekendu, liczba uderzeń innego zawodnika na polu, którego par nigdy nie podano, wynosiła {D}.
items.gloss_en: In a separate tournament held that same weekend, the number of strokes of another player on a course whose par was never given was {D}.
items.entity_note: a different tournament/event (a series) whose course's par is never stated, not simply a different player on a different course (a person) as in the first distractor, and not the player's own score on this course, whose par the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Inny przewoźnik autobusowy, którego rozkład nie jest tu podany, zanotował tego dnia rzeczywisty czas przyjazdu wynoszący {D} min po północy.
items.gloss_en: A different bus operator, whose timetable is not given here, recorded an actual arrival time that day of {D} min after midnight.
items.entity_note: a different transport operator (an organisation) with no schedule given for it, not a different train on a different line (an instrument/series) as in the first distractor, and not the train whose actual and scheduled arrival the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Portier pracujący w innej części miasta, gdzie w windzie nie oznaczono parteru jako poziomu odniesienia, korzysta codziennie z piętra oznaczonego numerem {D}.
items.gloss_en: A porter working in a different part of town, where the elevator has no ground floor marked as a reference, uses a floor numbered {D} every day.
items.entity_note: an individual porter (a person) with no reference/ground floor marked for him, not a different building's own elevator (a place) as in the first distractor, and not the elevator whose floor and reference the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Liczba bramek zdobytych w tym sezonie przez pojedynczego zawodnika, grającego w zupełnie innej lidze, wynosiła {D}.
items.gloss_en: The number of goals scored this season by a single player playing in a completely different league was {D}.
items.entity_note: an individual player in an unrelated league (a person), not a third team outside this match (an organisation) as in the first distractor, and not either team, Sokół or Orzeł, whose goals the question compares.
